title: HB1299 (2018 Regular): revise certain provisions regarding the lawful possession of firearms in certain locations.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2018-02-01; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/48430.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 48430, BillId 9224))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2018-02-01 (2018 print has no underline marks; the whole section is new). No passage vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section in SDCL ch. 22-14): No building, structure, park, campus, or other area may be posted as a firearm-free zone unless any person entering the area is required to pass through an electronic device to detect the presence of a firearm on the body of that person or unless personnel trained by the entity or a delegate of the entity posting the area are located in the area. The provisions of this section do not apply to: (1) Any county courthouse; (2) The state capitol; or (3) Any law enforcement office or building.
